query: SELECT T1.type_name, SUM(T3.load_capacity) FROM common.vehicle_type_dict AS T1 INNER JOIN transportation.vehicle AS T2 ON T1.type_code = T2.vehicle_type_code INNER JOIN transportation.vehicle_company AS T3 ON T2.company_id = T3.company_id GROUP BY T1.type_name
SELECT T1.status, COUNT(T1.status) FROM transportation.shipping_company AS T1 GROUP BY T1.status

SELECT T3.city_name, COUNT(T1.vehicle_id) FROM transportation.vehicle AS T1 INNER JOIN transportation.driver AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.driver_id INNER JOIN common.administrative_division AS T3 ON T2.area_id = T3.id INNER JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict AS T4 ON T1.vehicle_type_code = T4.type_code WHERE T3.province_name = '江苏省' GROUP BY T3.city_name

SELECT T1.business_type, COUNT(T1.company_id) FROM transportation.shipping_company AS T1 INNER JOIN transportation.employee AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T3 ON T2.company_id = T3.company_id GROUP BY T1.business_type
SELECT T1.business_type, COUNT(T1.company_id) FROM transportation.shipping_company AS T1 GROUP BY T1.business_type
SELECT COUNT(T1.mmsi) FROM transportation.vessel AS T1 INNER JOIN common.vessel_type_dict AS T2 ON T1.vessel_type = T2.type_code WHERE T1.max_load > 50000
SELECT COUNT(T1.driver_id) FROM transportation.driver AS T1 INNER JOIN common.license_type_dict AS T2 ON T1.license_type = T2.license_code WHERE T2.license_name = 'A2'
SELECT COUNT(T1.vehicle_id) FROM transportation.vehicle AS T1 INNER JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict AS T2 ON T1.vehicle_type_code = T2.type_code WHERE T1.area_id = 210000
SELECT COUNT(T.vehicle_id) FROM transportation.vehicle AS T WHERE T.area_id LIKE '36%'
SELECT COUNT(T.vehicle_id) FROM transportation.vehicle AS T WHERE T.area_id = '630000'
SELECT T1.mmsi FROM transportation.vessel AS T1 INNER JOIN common.vessel_type_dict AS T2 ON T1.vessel_type = T2.type_code WHERE T1.max_load < 5000
SELECT mmsi, sog FROM ais.vessel_ais_data WHERE sog > 10

SELECT T1.vehicle_id FROM transportation.vehicle AS T1 INNER JOIN transportation.driver AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.driver_id INNER JOIN transportation.vehicle_company AS T3 ON T1.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict AS T4 ON T1.vehicle_type_code = T4.type_code INNER JOIN common.license_type_dict AS T5 ON T2.license_type = T5.license_code WHERE T1.load_capacity IS NULL

SELECT T1.plate_number FROM transportation.vehicle AS T1 INNER JOIN transportation.driver AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.driver_id INNER JOIN transportation.vehicle_company AS T3 ON T1.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict AS T4 ON T1.vehicle_type_code = T4.type_code INNER JOIN common.license_type_dict AS T5 ON T2.license_type = T5.license_code WHERE T1.model = 'X5'
SELECT T1.name FROM transportation.driver AS T1 INNER JOIN common.license_type_dict AS T2 ON T1.license_type = T2.license_code WHERE T1.birth_date > '1990-01-01'
SELECT T1.name FROM transportation.employee AS T1 INNER JOIN transportation.shipping_company AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id WHERE T1.gender = '女'
SELECT T1.name FROM transportation.driver AS T1 INNER JOIN common.license_type_dict AS T2 ON T1.license_type = T2.license_code WHERE T2.license_name = 'C1'

SELECT T1.plate_number, T1.brand FROM transportation.vehicle AS T1 INNER JOIN transportation.driver AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.driver_id INNER JOIN transportation.vehicle_company AS T3 ON T1.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict AS T4 ON T1.vehicle_type_code = T4.type_code INNER JOIN ecommerce.orders AS T5 ON T3.company_id = T5.customer_id
SELECT T1.vehicle_id FROM transportation.vehicle AS T1 WHERE T1.load_capacity > ( SELECT AVG(load_capacity) FROM transportation.vehicle )

SELECT T1.company_name, COUNT(T3.product_id) FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.stocks AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN ecommerce.order_item AS T3 ON T2.stock_code = T3.product_id INNER JOIN common.dict_registration_type AS T4 ON T1.registration_type_code = T4.type_code WHERE T4.type_name = '车辆' GROUP BY T1.company_name
SELECT T1.company_name, SUM(T2.load_capacity) FROM transportation.vehicle_company AS T1 INNER JOIN transportation.vehicle AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id GROUP BY T1.company_name
SELECT T1.company_id, AVG(T2.max_speed) FROM transportation.shipping_company AS T1 INNER JOIN transportation.vessel AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id GROUP BY T1.company_id

SELECT T1.province_code, T3.type_name, COUNT(T2.vehicle_id) FROM common.administrative_division AS T1 INNER JOIN transportation.vehicle AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.area_id INNER JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict AS T3 ON T2.vehicle_type_code = T3.type_code WHERE T1.division_type = 'province' GROUP BY T1.province_code, T3.type_name
SELECT T1.brand, T2.province_code FROM ecommerce.product AS T1 INNER JOIN ecommerce.inventory AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id GROUP BY T1.brand, T2.province_code

SELECT AVG(T1.total_assets) FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T3 ON T1.industry_code = T3.industry_code WHERE T3.industry_name = '货车'

SELECT COUNT(T1.company_id) FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T2 ON T1.industry_code = T2.industry_code INNER JOIN common.dict_size_category AS T3 ON T1.size_category_code = T3.size_code INNER JOIN common.dict_registration_type AS T4 ON T1.registration_type_code = T4.type_code INNER JOIN ecommerce.orders AS T5 ON T1.company_id = T5.customer_id INNER JOIN ecommerce.inventory AS T6 ON T5.order_id = T6.inventory_id WHERE T2.industry_name = '重型货车' AND T5.receiver_city_code = '230100'
SELECT DISTINCT mmsi FROM ais.vessel_ais_data WHERE vessel_type = 35

SELECT T1.vehicle_id FROM transportation.vehicle AS T1 INNER JOIN transportation.vehicle_company AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T3 ON T2.company_name = T3.company_name INNER JOIN common.dict_registration_type AS T4 ON T3.registration_type_code = T4.type_code INNER JOIN common.dict_size_category AS T5 ON T3.size_category_code = T5.size_code WHERE T4.type_name = '长三角地区'

SELECT T1.vehicle_id, T1.plate_number, T1.brand, T1.model, T1.manufacture_year, T1.load_capacity, T1.color, T1.register_date, T1.insurance_expire FROM transportation.vehicle AS T1 INNER JOIN transportation.driver AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.driver_id INNER JOIN transportation.vehicle_company AS T3 ON T1.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict AS T4 ON T1.vehicle_type_code = T4.type_code INNER JOIN common.license_type_dict AS T5 ON T2.license_type = T5.license_code WHERE T1.brand = '福田' AND T1.load_capacity > 10

SELECT T1.size_name, COUNT(T3.vehicle_id) FROM common.dict_size_category AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T2 ON T1.size_code = T2.size_category_code INNER JOIN transportation.vehicle AS T3 ON T2.company_id = T3.company_id GROUP BY T1.size_name
SELECT T1.stock_name, T1.listing_date FROM finance_tax.stocks AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id WHERE T1.listing_date < '2015-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.company_id) FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.stocks AS T3 ON T1.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN common.dict_size_category AS T4 ON T1.size_category_code = T4.size_code INNER JOIN common.dict_registration_type AS T5 ON T1.registration_type_code = T5.type_code INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T6 ON T1.industry_code = T6.industry_code WHERE T2.tax_year = 2025

SELECT T3.open_price, T3.close_price FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.stocks AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades AS T3 ON T2.stock_id = T3.stock_id WHERE T1.stock_code = '000001' AND T3.trade_date = '2025-12-31'

SELECT COUNT(T1.company_id) FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.stocks AS T3 ON T1.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T4 ON T1.industry_code = T4.industry_code INNER JOIN common.dict_size_category AS T5 ON T1.size_category_code = T5.size_code INNER JOIN common.dict_registration_type AS T6 ON T1.registration_type_code = T6.type_code WHERE T2.is_restricted_industry = 0
SELECT T1.company_id, T1.stock_code, T1.stock_name, T1.current_price * T1.total_shares AS current_market_value FROM finance_tax.stocks AS T1 WHERE T1.market_class = 'A'

SELECT T1.company_name, T3.revenue FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns AS T3 ON T1.company_id = T3.company_id WHERE T3.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY T3.revenue DESC

SELECT T1.company_name, T2.revenue - T3.revenue AS diff FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns AS T3 ON T1.company_id = T3.company_id WHERE T2.tax_year = 2025 AND T3.tax_year = 2024

SELECT T1.company_name FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN common.dict_registration_type AS T3 ON T1.registration_type_code = T3.type_code INNER JOIN common.dict_size_category AS T4 ON T1.size_category_code = T4.size_code INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T5 ON T1.industry_code = T5.industry_code INNER JOIN finance_tax.stocks AS T6 ON T1.company_id = T6.company_id WHERE T3.type_name = '港澳台商投资企业' ORDER BY T2.revenue DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.industry_name, COUNT(T3.company_id) FROM common.dict_industry AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T2 ON T1.industry_code = T2.industry_code INNER JOIN finance_tax.stocks AS T3 ON T2.company_id = T3.company_id WHERE T2.is_private = 1 GROUP BY T1.industry_name

SELECT (T1.total_assets - T1.total_liabilities) / T2.total_shares AS net_assets_per_share FROM finance_tax.company_financials AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.stocks AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T3 ON T1.company_id = T3.company_id WHERE T3.company_name = '贵州茅台' AND T1.report_date = '2025-03-31'

SELECT T1.stock_id, SUM(T2.high_price - T2.low_price) / SUM(T2.close_price) FROM finance_tax.stocks AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades AS T2 ON T1.stock_id = T2.stock_id WHERE T2.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY T1.stock_id

SELECT T1.stock_name FROM finance_tax.stocks AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.company_financials AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades AS T3 ON T1.stock_id = T3.stock_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T4 ON T1.company_id = T4.company_id INNER JOIN common.dict_stock_type AS T5 ON T1.share_right_type = T5.type_code WHERE T5.type_name = 'Common Stock' ORDER BY T3.close_price / (T2.total_assets - T2.total_liabilities) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT AVG(T1.revenue - T1.non_taxable_income - T1.deductions - T1.prior_year_losses) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN common.dict_registration_type AS T3 ON T2.registration_type_code = T3.type_code INNER JOIN common.dict_size_category AS T4 ON T2.size_category_code = T4.size_code INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T5 ON T2.industry_code = T5.industry_code WHERE T1.tax_year = 2025

SELECT SUM(T1.revenue - T1.non_taxable_income - T1.deductions - T1.prior_year_losses) * 0.25 - SUM(T1.revenue - T1.non_taxable_income - T1.deductions - T1.prior_year_losses) * 0.15 FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.stocks AS T3 ON T2.company_id = T3.company_id WHERE T3.stock_name = '腾讯控股' AND T1.tax_year = 2024

SELECT SUM(T1.revenue - T1.non_taxable_income - T1.deductions - T1.prior_year_losses) / SUM(T1.revenue) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.stocks AS T3 ON T2.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.company_financials AS T4 ON T2.company_id = T4.company_id WHERE T2.company_name = '中国中车' AND T1.tax_year = 2025 AND T4.report_date = '2025-12-31'

SELECT (SELECT T1.dividend_cash / T2.total_assets * 100 FROM finance_tax.company_financials AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T3 ON T2.industry_code = T3.industry_code WHERE T2.company_name = '中国石化' AND T1.report_date = '2025-12-31') - (SELECT AVG(T1.dividend_cash / T2.total_assets * 100) FROM finance_tax.company_financials AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T3 ON T2.industry_code = T3.industry_code WHERE T3.industry_name = '石油和天然气开采业' AND T1.report_date = '2025-12-31') AS diff FROM finance_tax.companies AS T2 INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T3 ON T2.industry_code = T3.industry_code WHERE T2.company_name = '中国石化'

SELECT T1.company_name FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.stocks AS T3 ON T1.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN common.dict_size_category AS T4 ON T1.size_category_code = T4.size_code INNER JOIN common.dict_registration_type AS T5 ON T1.registration_type_code = T5.type_code INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T6 ON T1.industry_code = T6.industry_code WHERE T2.non_taxable_income / T2.revenue > 0.5

SELECT T1.industry_name, AVG(CASE WHEN T3.is_private = 1 THEN T2.revenue - T2.non_taxable_income - T2.deductions - T2.prior_year_losses ELSE 0 END) AS private_avg, AVG(CASE WHEN T3.is_private = 0 THEN T2.revenue - T2.non_taxable_income - T2.deductions - T2.prior_year_losses ELSE 0 END) AS state_avg FROM common.dict_industry AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns AS T2 ON T2.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T3 ON T3.industry_code = T1.industry_code GROUP BY T1.industry_name

SELECT T1.stock_id, SQRT(POWER(AVG(T3.close_price - T4.close_price), 2) * 250) AS annual_volatility FROM finance_tax.stocks AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades AS T3 ON T1.stock_id = T3.stock_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades AS T4 ON T1.stock_id = T4.stock_id AND T4.trade_date = DATE_SUB(T3.trade_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE T3.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY T1.stock_id

SELECT T1.stock_code FROM finance_tax.stocks AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.company_financials AS T3 ON T2.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades AS T4 ON T1.stock_id = T4.stock_id INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T5 ON T2.industry_code = T5.industry_code WHERE T3.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND T4.trade_date = '2025-12-31' AND T3.dividend_cash / T4.close_price > ( SELECT AVG(T3.dividend_cash / T4.close_price) FROM finance_tax.stocks AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.company_financials AS T3 ON T2.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades AS T4 ON T1.stock_id = T4.stock_id INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T5 ON T2.industry_code = T5.industry_code WHERE T3.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND T4.trade_date = '2025-12-31' AND T5.industry_name = ( SELECT T5.industry_name FROM finance_tax.stocks AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.company_financials AS T3 ON T2.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades AS T4 ON T1.stock_id = T4.stock_id INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T5 ON T2.industry_code = T5.industry_code WHERE T3.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND T4.trade_date = '2025-12-31' ) )

SELECT T1.company_name FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T2 ON T1.industry_code = T2.industry_code INNER JOIN common.dict_size_category AS T3 ON T1.size_category_code = T3.size_code INNER JOIN finance_tax.stocks AS T4 ON T1.company_id = T4.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.company_financials AS T5 ON T1.company_id = T5.company_id WHERE T2.industry_name = '电力、热力、燃气及水生产和供应业' AND T3.size_name = '微型'

SELECT T1.station_name FROM energy.energy_station AS T1 INNER JOIN common.station_type_dict AS T2 ON T1.station_type_code = T2.type_code INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T3 ON T1.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T4 ON T3.industry_code = T4.industry_code WHERE T4.industry_name = '拉萨市'

SELECT T1.station_name FROM energy.energy_station AS T1 INNER JOIN common.station_type_dict AS T2 ON T1.station_type_code = T2.type_code INNER JOIN common.energy_type_dict AS T3 ON T1.energy_type_code = T3.type_code WHERE T2.type_name = '发电场站' AND T1.grid_connect_date > '2020-01-01'

SELECT T1.company_name FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.company_financials AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T3 ON T1.industry_code = T3.industry_code WHERE T3.industry_name = '发电、输电、变电和配电' AND T2.total_assets > ( SELECT AVG(T2.total_assets) FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.company_financials AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T3 ON T1.industry_code = T3.industry_code WHERE T3.industry_name = '发电、输电、变电和配电' )

SELECT T1.education, COUNT(T1.employee_id) FROM energy.employee AS T1 INNER JOIN energy.energy_company AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id INNER JOIN common.energy_position_dict AS T3 ON T1.position_code = T3.position_code WHERE T2.company_name LIKE '西藏电力%' AND T3.category = '管理' GROUP BY T1.education

SELECT T3.type_name, COUNT(T1.station_id) FROM energy.energy_station AS T1 INNER JOIN common.administrative_division AS T2 ON T1.area_id = T2.id INNER JOIN common.energy_type_dict AS T3 ON T1.energy_type_code = T3.type_code WHERE T2.division_name = '格尔木市' GROUP BY T3.type_name

SELECT COUNT(T1.company_id) FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T2 ON T1.industry_code = T2.industry_code INNER JOIN finance_tax.company_financials AS T3 ON T1.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.stocks AS T4 ON T1.company_id = T4.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades AS T5 ON T4.stock_id = T5.stock_id INNER JOIN common.dict_size_category AS T6 ON T1.size_category_code = T6.size_code WHERE T2.industry_name = '电力、热力生产和供应业'

SELECT AVG(CURDATE() - T1.established_year) FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T2 ON T1.industry_code = T2.industry_code INNER JOIN finance_tax.stocks AS T3 ON T1.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns AS T4 ON T1.company_id = T4.company_id WHERE T2.industry_name = '电力、热力生产和供应业' GROUP BY T3.share_right_type

SELECT T2.position_name, COUNT(T1.employee_id) FROM energy.employee AS T1 INNER JOIN common.energy_position_dict AS T2 ON T1.position_code = T2.position_code GROUP BY T2.position_name ORDER BY COUNT(T1.employee_id) DESC
SELECT T1.area_id, COUNT(T1.station_id) FROM energy.energy_station AS T1 WHERE T1.energy_type_code = 'PV' GROUP BY T1.area_id

SELECT T1.type_name, AVG(T3.employee_count) FROM common.dict_registration_type AS T1 INNER JOIN finance_tax.companies AS T2 ON T1.type_code = T2.registration_type_code INNER JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns AS T3 ON T2.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T4 ON T2.industry_code = T4.industry_code WHERE T4.industry_name = '电力、热力生产和供应业' GROUP BY T1.type_name

SELECT COUNT(T1.company_id) FROM finance_tax.companies AS T1 INNER JOIN common.dict_industry AS T2 ON T1.industry_code = T2.industry_code INNER JOIN finance_tax.stocks AS T3 ON T1.company_id = T3.company_id INNER JOIN finance_tax.company_financials AS T4 ON T1.company_id = T4.company_id WHERE T2.industry_name = '电力、热力、燃气及水生产和供应业'

SELECT COUNT(T2.employee_id) FROM energy.energy_station AS T1 INNER JOIN energy.employee AS T2 ON T1.station_id = T2.station_id INNER JOIN common.station_type_dict AS T3 ON T1.station_type_code = T3.type_code WHERE T3.type_name = '火电厂' AND T1.station_name LIKE '徐州%'

SELECT COUNT(T1.employee_id) FROM energy.employee AS T1 INNER JOIN energy.energy_station AS T2 ON T1.station_id = T2.station_id INNER JOIN common.station_type_dict AS T3 ON T2.station_type_code = T3.type_code WHERE T3.type_name = '火电厂' AND T2.station_name LIKE '呼伦贝尔%'

SELECT COUNT(T1.employee_id) FROM energy.employee AS T1 INNER JOIN energy.energy_station AS T2 ON T1.station_id = T2.station_id INNER JOIN common.station_type_dict AS T3 ON T2.station_type_code = T3.type_code WHERE T3.type_name = '火电厂' AND T2.station_name LIKE '安庆%'

SELECT COUNT(T1.employee_id) FROM energy.employee AS T1 INNER JOIN energy.energy_station AS T2 ON T1.station_id = T2.station_id INNER JOIN common.station_type_dict AS T3 ON T2.station_type_code = T3.type_code WHERE T3.type_name = '水电站' AND T2.station_name LIKE '甘孜%'
